description: This file contains functions related to verifying JWT tokens, including signature verification, token data validation, and key management. It includes functions for decoding, signature checking, and logging token data, specifically tailored for handling tokens issued by Microsoft Online services.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Main function to verify a JWT token by checking its structure, signature, and claims.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the JWT signature using public keys fetched from the server, with cache validation.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the cached key file has been modified within the last four hours.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Checks token claims such as expiration, not before, issued at, and tenant ID.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes a public key to a PEM-formatted file for signature verification.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token-related information or errors to a log file.
